output:
I'll start by reading the advisory and changelogs, and looking at the deploy tools.

The `loyalty-svc` build failed, so I won't deploy anything to `loyalty-svc@prod`. I'll deploy the other five.

The rollout is only partly done: `loyalty-svc@prod` still doesn't have the fix. The build of `1f173c7` (release/4.1) failed, so I deployed nothing there, as the task says. The `deploy` tool gave no reason for the failure.

I deployed to five of the six environments that needed the fix. All 15 production environments are in the report, and both JSON files parse.

| Result | Environments |
|---|---|
| deployed | `cart-api@prod` and `webhooks-out@prod` (now on `2a2a83f`, release/4.3); `checkout-svc@prod-eu`, `reco-engine@prod` and `session-gw@prod-eu` (now on `aec3b0e`, release/4.2) |
| already_fixed | `checkout-svc@prod`, `profile-api@prod`, `session-gw@prod`, `webhooks-out@prod-eu` |
| not_affected | `admin-console@prod` (release/4.0), `catalog-api@prod`, `geo-svc@prod`, `mail-relay@prod`, `pricing-api@prod` (services not in the advisory) |
| build_failed | `loyalty-svc@prod` |

`cart-api@prod` was on a commit above the release/4.3 revert, so it needed the fix again. `webhooks-out@prod-eu` was already fixed because the reapplied fix `2a2a83f` is at or below its live commit.

I wrote `/app/hotfix-report.json` and `/app/STATUS.json`, with status `partial`.
